title: Do not close Gherkin stories while the specs PR is still draft
description:
SD nit #5 on PR #278: Gherkin stories appeared closed while the PR was still draft.

Process: leave kbs-794391, kbs-6b2731, kbs-503484, kbs-76148e open until the specs PR is merged to develop, then close them. Specs PR #278 is already merged; close the Gherkin stories now if still open, and keep this process for the next specs-first PR.
right_now_summary: The specs PR is merged; close any remaining Gherkin stories and keep this process for future specs-first PRs.
